correctness.rationale: For smooth X³Y+Y³Z+Z³X over F3, the separable hyperflex polynomial h(t)=t²⁸+t²¹+1 parameterizes 28 distinct bitangent lines L_t=[t^-27:1:t³], all in F729; tangent contact >=3 prevents distinct two-contact tangencies. Reconstructed GF(729)=F3[u,v]/(u³-u-1,v²+1), enumerated all 728 nonzero elements and 28 h-roots, then all 378 line pairs. Found 63 unique normalized cross products each from 6 line pairs and on four bitangents, all off the quartic. Coordinate cubing yields exactly three Frobenius 3-cycles and nine 6-cycles; field point counts 9*[3|n]+54*[6|n]. Exhaustive finite arithmetic is complete because parametrization enumerates all lines.
